title.zh: 缺一个格子的 Snaky 是一手威胁
title.en: A Snaky missing one cell is a one-move threat

given.zh: $S$ 本身包含一个 Snaky；Maker 已拥有 $S \setminus \{p\}$，Breaker 尚未占据 $S$ 中任何格子。
given.en: $S$ contains a Snaky, Maker owns $S \setminus \{p\}$, and Breaker occupies no cell of $S$.

claim.zh: $\mathrm{Threat}(\mathrm{HasSnaky}, S \setminus \{p\}, S, 1)$ 成立，因而六个基础行都有真正的博弈含义。
claim.en: $\mathrm{Threat}(\mathrm{HasSnaky}, S \setminus \{p\}, S, 1)$ holds, giving all six base rows a game-theoretic meaning.

statement.en: If $p\in M$, then $S\subseteq M$ because $S\setminus\{p\}\subseteq M$.

reason.zh: S 中等于 $p$ 的点由本分支给出，其余点由威胁的所需点条件给出；此时目标图形已经出现。
reason.en: The branch assumption supplies $p$ and the requirement supplies every other cell of $S$, so the target shape is already present.

statement.zh: $p\notin M$ 且 $p\in S \Rightarrow p\notin B$，Maker 可落 $p$，随后 $S\subseteq M\cup\{p\}$。
statement.en: If $p\notin M$ and $p\in S$, then $p\notin B$; Maker may claim $p$ and obtain $S\subseteq M\cup\{p\}$.

reason.zh: $H=S$ 与 $B$ 不交保证这个缺失格未被对手占据；若 $p$ 根本不在 $S$ 中，$S\setminus\{p\}=S$ 已使目标成立。
reason.en: Disjointness of $H=S$ from $B$ makes the missing cell legal. If $p$ is not in $S$ at all, $S\setminus\{p\}=S$ already gives the goal.

statement.zh: $\mathrm{HasSnaky}(M')$ 在 $M'$ 扩大时保持，故可得到精确的一手 Winning。
statement.en: $\mathrm{HasSnaky}(M')$ persists when $M'$ grows, giving the required one-move Winning statement.

reason.zh: 目标已出现时可选择新空格补足这一步；目标尚缺 $p$ 时，落 $p$ 后的任意合法回复都不改变 Maker 已拥有的 $S$。
reason.en: If the goal already holds, a fresh legal cell pads the move. Otherwise claiming $p$ completes $S$, and any legal reply leaves Maker’s set intact.

title.zh: 对手一手不能同时阻断全部分支
title.en: One reply cannot block every branch

given.zh: 每个 child 都是 $\le n$ 手威胁；各 $A_i \subseteq A\cup\{p\}$、$H_i \subseteq H$，且 $p\in H$、$\bigcap H_i \subseteq A\cup\{p\}$。假设 $A\subseteq M$、$H\cap B=\emptyset$。
given.en: Each child is a threat of at most $n$ moves, with $A_i \subseteq A\cup\{p\}$, $H_i \subseteq H$, $p\in H$ and $\bigcap H_i \subseteq A\cup\{p\}$. Assume $A\subseteq M$ and $H\cap B=\emptyset$.

claim.zh: 这些 child 合成一个 $n+1$ 手威胁。
claim.en: The children combine into a threat of $n+1$ moves.

statement.zh: $p\notin M \Rightarrow p\notin M\cup B$，可先合法落 $p$。
statement.en: If $p\notin M$, then $p\notin M\cup B$, so claiming $p$ is legal.

reason.zh: $p\in H$ 而 $H\cap B=\emptyset$ 排除 $p\in B$；落子后所有 $A_i\subseteq A\cup\{p\}\subseteq M\cup\{p\}$ 都已被 Maker 满足。
reason.en: $p\in H$ and $H\cap B=\emptyset$ exclude $p\in B$. After the move, $A_i\subseteq A\cup\{p\}\subseteq M\cup\{p\}$ satisfies every child requirement.

statement.zh:
合法回复 $b
otin M\cup\{p\} \Rightarrow b
otin A\cup\{p\} \Rightarrow \exists i$，$b
otin H_i$。
statement.en:
A legal reply $b
otin M\cup\{p\}$ gives $b
otin A\cup\{p\}$, hence some $i$ has $b
otin H_i$.

reason.zh: 若 $b$ 属于所有 $H_i$，交集条件会把它放进 $A\cup\{p\}$，与合法性矛盾。这里选择的 child 可以随对手回复而改变。
reason.en: If $b$ belonged to every $H_i$, the intersection condition would place it in $A\cup\{p\}$, contradicting legality. The chosen child may depend on the reply.

statement.zh: $H_i\cap(B\cup\{b\})=\emptyset$，因此该 child 在剩余至多 $n$ 手内完成。
statement.en: $H_i\cap(B\cup\{b\})=\emptyset$, so the selected child succeeds in at most $n$ further moves.

reason.zh: 原先 $H_i\subseteq H$ 已排除旧 $B$，上一行又排除新点 $b$；结合已满足的 $A_i$，就能应用 child 的 Threat。
reason.en: The inclusion $H_i\subseteq H$ excludes the old $B$, and the previous line excludes $b$. Together with $A_i$, these are exactly the selected Threat’s hypotheses.

statement.zh: 若 $p\in M$，直接取任一 child，再把其高度补到 $n+1$。
statement.en: If $p\in M$, choose any child and pad its height to $n+1$.

reason.zh: 此时 $A_i$ 已在 $M$ 中，包络也未受阻；非空 child 列表提供可选分支，目标单调性允许使用 winning_mono_time。
reason.en: All $A_i$ are already owned and their envelopes unblocked. The nonempty list supplies a child, and monotonicity permits winning_mono_time.

title.zh: 按 child 索引严格递减，把整张表解释为策略
title.en: Interpret the whole table by descending child indices

given.zh: qTableValid 保证每项非空且 $\mathrm{child} <$ 当前行号；六个基础行已是威胁，旋转平移保持 HasSnaky。
given.en: qTableValid gives nonempty entries with child indices below the current row; base rows are threats, and rotations and translations preserve HasSnaky.

statement.zh: $i<6$：第 $i$ 行是平移后的 $S\setminus\{p\}$，高度为 $1$。
statement.en: For $i<6$, row $i$ is a translated $S\setminus\{p\}$, with height one.

reason.zh: 基础行把 Snaky 的六个可能缺口逐一移到原点；前面的叶威胁因此覆盖所有基础索引。
reason.en: The base rows translate each of Snaky’s six possible missing cells to the origin. The leaf-threat argument covers every base index.

reason.zh: 强归纳允许直接使用所有较小索引的结论；旋转平移是格点双射，连同 HasSnaky 的图形见证一起搬运该威胁。
reason.en: Strong induction supplies all smaller indices. Rotate and translate each threat along a cell bijection, transporting its HasSnaky witness as well.

statement.zh: 把已放置 child 代入 fork：父高度 $1+\max h_j$，得到第 $i$ 行的 Threat。
statement.en: Fork the placed children at height $1+\max h_j$ to obtain the Threat for row $i$.

reason.zh: fork 的 $A$、$H$ 定义正好保证上一阶段所需的包含与交集条件；因此归纳从六个叶行扩展到全部 $i<616$。
reason.en: The fork definitions of $A$ and $H$ supply the required containments and intersection condition. This extends the six leaf cases to every $i<616$.

title.zh: 把开局分支合成空棋盘的 35 手必胜性
title.en: Combine the opening branches into a 35-move win from empty

given.zh: $12$ 个高度 $\le 33$ 的分支先组成 $34$ 手的 escape 威胁；平移后它只要求 Maker 已占原点。它与关键行的旋转平移共组成 $24$ 个根分支。
given.en: Twelve branches of height $\le 33$ first form a $34$-move escape threat; after translation it requires only the origin. Together with placements of the distinguished rows, it forms $24$ root branches.

claim.zh: 根分支全部满足 $A_i \subseteq \{o\}$、$\mathrm{height}_i \le 34$、$\bigcap H_i \subseteq \{o\}$，所以 $\mathrm{Winning}(\mathrm{qGoal},35,\emptyset,\emptyset)$。
claim.en: Every root branch has $A_i \subseteq \{o\}$ and $\mathrm{height}_i \le 34$, while $\bigcap H_i \subseteq \{o\}$; hence $\mathrm{Winning}(\mathrm{qGoal},35,\emptyset,\emptyset)$.

statement.zh: $12$ 个 child 的高度 $\le 33 \Rightarrow$ escape 的高度为 $34$，所需点为 $\{(0,-1)\}$。
statement.en: Twelve children of height $\le 33$ yield an escape threat of height $34$ requiring $\{(0,-1)\}$.

reason.zh: 这些 child 的 $A$ 都在 $\{(0,-1),o\}$ 内，共同 $H$ 也只可能落在这两个点；在 $o$ 分叉后从所需集删去 $o$。
reason.en: The child requirements and common envelope lie in $\{(0,-1),o\}$. Forking at $o$ removes $o$ from the parent requirement.

statement.zh: 将 escape 平移 $(0,1)$，其所需点变成 $\{o\}$。
statement.en: Translate escape by $(0,1)$, turning its required set into $\{o\}$.

reason.zh: $(0,-1)+(0,1)=o$；平移保持威胁和高度，所以它可以和关键行的其他放置一起作为根分支。
reason.en: $(0,-1)+(0,1)=o$. Translation preserves the threat and its height, allowing it to join the placed distinguished rows as a root branch.

statement.en: The $24$ root children satisfy $A_i\subseteq\{o\}$, $h_i\le 34$ and $\bigcap H_i\subseteq\{o\}$.

reason.zh: 前两项由 qroot_A_bound、qroot_child_height 逐项核对；qroot_common_bound 排除每个原点外的共同包络点。
reason.en: qroot_A_bound and qroot_child_height verify the first two clauses; qroot_common_bound excludes all non-origin common-envelope cells.

statement.zh: Maker 首手取 $o \Rightarrow$ 任意合法回复后仍有一个 child，故 $1+34=35$。
statement.en: Maker opens at $o$; some child survives every legal reply, giving $1+34=35$.

reason.zh: 对手不能回复 $o$，因而不能同时落入全部根包络。分叉定理得到所需点为空的 $35$ 手威胁，在空棋盘上即可直接使用。
reason.en: The reply cannot be $o$ and therefore cannot belong to every root envelope. The fork theorem yields a $35$-move threat with no required cells, applicable from the empty board.

title.zh: 提取策略，并跟踪每一步的合法状态
title.en: Extract the policy and track legal states

given.zh: $\mathrm{Winning}(\mathrm{HasSnaky},35,\emptyset,\emptyset)$ 已证。对手 $\beta$ 只需在最后一手之前满足 LegalRepliesBeforeFinal。
given.en: $\mathrm{Winning}(\mathrm{HasSnaky},35,\emptyset,\emptyset)$ is established. The opponent $\beta$ satisfies LegalRepliesBeforeFinal, which requires legality only before the final Maker move.

claim.zh: 存在始终不落入 $M\cup B$ 的 $\sigma$；任意这样的 $\beta$ 都使 Maker 第 $35$ 手后包含 Snaky、恰有 $35$ 子，且与 Breaker 的前 $34$ 子不交。每个 $k<35$ 的中间状态双方不交，Breaker 恰有 $k$ 子。
claim.en: There is a $\sigma$ that always avoids $M\cup B$. For every such $\beta$, Maker has a Snaky and exactly $35$ cells after move $35$, disjoint from Breaker’s first $34$ cells. At every $k<35$ the two sets are disjoint and Breaker has exactly $k$ cells.

statement.zh: $\sigma(n,M,B)$ 取 Winning 的合法首手；若无见证，则取 $M\cup B$ 外的新格。
statement.en: $\sigma(n,M,B)$ chooses a legal first move from Winning, or a fresh cell outside $M\cup B$ when no witness exists.

reason.zh: 棋盘 $\mathbb{Z}^2$ 无限而 $M\cup B$ 有限，因此后备落点始终存在。这让 $\sigma$ 在每个输入局面都有定义并始终合法。
reason.en: The board $\mathbb{Z}^2$ is infinite and $M\cup B$ finite, so the fallback always exists. Thus $\sigma$ is defined and legal on every input state.

reason.zh: $k=0$ 来自空棋盘结论；对 $k\le 33$，合法的 $\beta_k$ 使 winningPolicy_step 把剩余手数减一。每次双方插入新格，同时保持不交。
reason.en: The $k=0$ case is the empty-board result. For $k\le 33$, legal $\beta_k$ lets winningPolicy_step reduce the remaining moves by one, while fresh insertions preserve disjointness.

statement.zh: $k=34$ 时剩余 $1$ 手；第 $35$ 个 Maker 落点后，$\mathrm{HasSnaky}(M_{35})$。
statement.en: At $k=34$ one move remains; after Maker’s $35$th move, $\mathrm{HasSnaky}(M_{35})$ holds.

reason.zh: 一手 Winning 的结论只取决于插入 Maker 落点后的集合。证明选一个辅助合法回复来读取该结论，不要求实际的 $\beta_{34}$ 合法。
reason.en: The one-move Winning conclusion depends only on Maker’s updated set. The proof uses an auxiliary fresh legal reply to read it, without assuming legality of the actual $\beta_{34}$.

reason.zh: Maker 总选新格，故每次基数加一；前 $34$ 次合法回复同理。最后一次 Maker 只需避开已经存在的 $B_{34}$。
reason.en: Every Maker move is fresh, increasing its cardinality by one; the first $34$ legal replies do likewise. The final Maker move avoids the already existing $B_{34}$.
